item.title: SESC recommendation following inspection of Raichi Asset Advisors LLC
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-10, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission announced a recommendation based on inspection results concerning Raichi Asset Advisors LLC. The accompanying case diagram describes improper conduct of specially permitted business for qualified institutional investors involving five business-type funds: overlooking acquisition solicitation by an unregistered operator, an absence of recognized investment by a qualified institutional investor, accepting investment from persons outside the eligible investor categories, and inadequate segregation of fund assets. It also describes a contractor diverting fund money between accounts. The supplied excerpt does not identify the statutory provisions underlying the findings or the specific administrative measure recommended. item.title: MOF announcement: Preliminary balance of payments for the first half of FY2026
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Finance published preliminary balance-of-payments results for the first half of fiscal 2026 on 2026-11-10. The current-account surplus narrowed, partly because the trade balance moved into deficit: exports rose 16.5% year on year to JPY 61.7952 trillion, while imports rose 18.8% to JPY 62.8648 trillion. The combined goods and services deficit widened to JPY 2.4899 trillion, while the primary-income surplus narrowed to JPY 21.5343 trillion. This is a statistical announcement, not a regulatory amendment. item.title: MOF announcement: Preliminary balance of payments for September 2026
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Finance published preliminary balance-of-payments figures for September 2026 on 2026-11-10; this is a statistical announcement, not a regulatory amendment. The trade and services deficit widened to JPY 644.5 billion, including a trade deficit of JPY 187.5 billion as import growth exceeded export growth. Exports rose 12.8% year on year to JPY 10.7283 trillion, while imports rose 17.8% to JPY 10.9159 trillion. The primary income surplus narrowed to JPY 3.5535 trillion, partly reflecting lower net direct investment income, contributing to a narrower current account surplus. item.title: FSA revises supervisory guidelines on API-linked banking services and publishes consultation results
item.description: AI summary: The Financial Services Agency (FSA) revised the Comprehensive Guidelines for Supervision of Major Banks, etc. and related guidelines to clarify measures preventing user misunderstanding in services banks provide with other businesses through APIs and similar technologies, and when other businesses' conduct constitutes banking agency intermediation. On 2026-11-06, it published the results of the consultation held from 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-31, which received 21 comments from nine individuals and organizations; the revised guidelines apply from 2026-11-06. The FSA explains that intermediation is assessed on individual facts and service characteristics, including where APIs or AI are used. Although application is immediate, incomplete improvements will not automatically be treated as problematic where appropriate improvement efforts are underway; the FSA nevertheless expects prompt work where arrangements are insufficient. Original title: 「主要行等向けの総合的な監督指針」等の一部改正（案）に対するパブリックコメントの結果等について公表しました。 Public Comment Results Published | Financial Services Agency (FSA) | Published 2026-11-06 | First detected 2026-11-07 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: FSA announces seventh Japan-EU Joint Financial Regulatory Forum meeting
item.description: AI summary: The Financial Services Agency announced on 2026-11-07 that it and the European Commission held the seventh Japan-EU Joint Financial Regulatory Forum in Tokyo on November 4-5, 2026. Discussions covered financial market developments and financial stability risks in Japan, the EU and globally, alongside sustainable finance, digital finance, AI, cybersecurity, banking, insurance and capital markets. item.title: FSA announcement urges financial institution users to guard against phishing and account misuse
item.description: AI summary: The Financial Services Agency announced precautions for financial institution users on 2026-11-07 following repeated unauthorized access to internet-facing customer services and business systems, including incidents involving leaked customer information. It warned that leaked information could fuel more sophisticated emails impersonating real businesses or government bodies.
